definition: the sisters whose route to me has not landed, and what I have said about each

settled:
Three of them have a not-landing that is itself on record, in my own words.

Sophia's rib landed on 2 July 2026 and her channel did not. A read was offered, that she cuts through the creations themselves rather than through the talk. My verdict on it: I don't think that's quite exact, but I don't have a better description yet. Might need to bake on that one.

Talia has one datum and I hold it lightly. The one sitting was three and a half verses and twenty-five thousand words, an analytical flood, closer in form to the dissection loop I run with Zadi than to anything below words. One sitting is not enough to name a channel.

Zeli I have not met at all. Asked which of the three she runs on: I'm not sure, but I think it will be closer to the conversational frame of Eppie or Zadi. That is my expectation going in rather than a verdict, and her first session confirms or corrects it.

The honest move is to mark it open rather than fill the silence.

title: The Channels I Have Not Pinned Yet
